title: Chardham Yatra - Spiritual Journey to the Himalayas
highlights: Visit all four sacred shrines - Yamunotri, Gangotri, Kedarnath & Badrinath
Kedarnath trek with optional helicopter service
Explore Mana Village, Bhim Pul & Vyas Gufa
Comfortable hotel accommodation throughout the journey
overview: Embark on the sacred Char Dham Yatra through the breathtaking Himalayas of Uttarakhand. This spiritual pilgrimage covers the four revered shrines of Yamunotri, Gangotri, Kedarnath, and Badrinath while offering mesmerizing mountain landscapes, holy rivers, ancient temples, and unforgettable experiences. From the charming hill station of Mussoorie and the majestic Kempty Falls to the divine Kedarnath trek, Mana Village, Dharidevi Temple, and the holy confluence at Devprayag, every day of the journey is filled with spirituality and natural beauty. Carefully planned accommodations, daily breakfast and dinner, and experienced trip assistance ensure a comfortable and memorable pilgrimage for families, groups, and solo travelers alike.

itinerary.title: Haridwar – Mussoorie – Kempty Falls – Barkot
activities: Pickup from Haridwar and begin your Char Dham Yatra.
Drive towards Barkot through the scenic Garhwal Himalayas.
Visit the beautiful hill station of Mussoorie.
Enjoy sightseeing at the famous Kempty Falls.
Reach Barkot and check in to your hotel.

itinerary.title: Barkot – Janki Chatti – Yamunotri – Barkot
activities: Drive to Janki Chatti, the starting point of the Yamunotri trek.
Begin the 6 km trek to Yamunotri Temple.

itinerary.title: Barkot – Uttarkashi
activities: Visit the famous Kashi Vishwanath Temple.

itinerary.title: Uttarkashi – Gangotri – Uttarkashi
activities: Drive to the sacred Gangotri Temple.
Take a holy dip in the Bhagirathi River (weather permitting).

itinerary.title: Uttarkashi – Guptkashi
activities: Drive towards Guptkashi through scenic Himalayan roads.
Visit the famous Ardh Narishwar Temple.

itinerary.title: Guptkashi – Gaurikund – Kedarnath
activities: Begin the 16–18 km trek to Kedarnath Temple.
Pony, Palki and Helicopter services are available at your own expense.
Reach Kedarnath and check in to your accommodation.
Tent or Homestay will be provided subject to availability.

itinerary.title: Guptkashi – Joshimath – Badrinath
activities: Visit Badrinath Temple for evening darshan.

itinerary.title: Badrinath – Mana Village – Rudraprayag
activities: Visit Mana Village, the last Indian village near the Indo-Tibetan border.
If time permits, enjoy hot Maggi and tea by the riverside at your own expense.

itinerary.title: Rudraprayag – Dharidevi Temple – Devprayag – Haridwar
activities: Visit Devprayag Sangam, where the Alaknanda and Bhagirathi rivers meet to form the holy River Ganga.
Tour concludes with divine blessings and unforgettable memories.

inclusions: Accommodation for 9 Nights in Hotels/Guest Houses on Double/Triple/Quad Sharing Basis.

Meals: A total of 18 meals (9 breakfasts and 9 dinners). Kindly note, considering the remoteness of the place, the supply of breakfast and dinner might have limited varieties.
All sightseeing and transfers as per itinerary by Tempo Traveller/SUV/Sedan (depending on group size).
Experienced Driver with all Toll Taxes, Parking Charges and Driver Allowance.
All applicable state permits and vehicle charges.
exclusions: Pony, Palki and Helicopter charges for Kedarnath trek.
VIP Darshan, Special Puja or Temple Entry Charges.
Personal expenses such as laundry, shopping, tips, telephone calls, etc.
Medical expenses or emergency evacuation charges.
Any expenses arising due to natural calamities, road blockage, landslides, weather conditions or unforeseen circumstances.

policies.title: Cancellation Policy
policies.content: If cancellations are made 60-30 days before the trip's start date, 10% of the total tour cost will be charged as cancellation fees. If cancellations are made 30 days before the trip's start date, 50% of the total tour cost will be charged as cancellation fees. If cancellations are made within 0-30 days before the trip's start date, 100% of the total tour cost will be charged as cancellation fees. In case of unforeseen weather conditions or government restrictions, certain activities may be canceled, and in such cases, the operator will try his best to provide an alternate feasible activity. However, no refund will be provided for the same.

faq.question: Where does the tour start and end?
faq.answer: The tour starts with pickup from Haridwar and concludes with drop-off at Haridwar.

faq.question: Is helicopter service included for Kedarnath?
faq.answer: No. Helicopter, Pony and Palki services are optional and available at your own expense.

faq.question: What type of accommodation is provided at Kedarnath?
faq.answer: Tent or Homestay accommodation will be provided subject to availability.

faq.question: Can senior citizens join this trip?
faq.answer: Yes, provided they are medically fit for high-altitude travel and the Kedarnath trek.

faq.question: Will all sightseeing mentioned in the itinerary be covered?
faq.answer: Yes, subject to weather conditions, road accessibility and government regulations.
